purpose: Verify automatic stop, terminal combat-log export and cleanup after restored full-route native clear

acceptance.setup: Full manifest executes in one worldserver; no skipped predecessor or manual killing.
acceptance.repair: Trash engagement and lawful route progress are observed.
acceptance.clear: Native Magmaw death required, watchdog timeout is failure.
acceptance.performance: Unaccepted until matched per-actor review; retain exact elapsed damage/healing and missing observations.
acceptance.controller: Stop at observed ordered clear independently of certification; export combat log before native shutdown.
